transcription.text: hey everybody scott johnson here and if you're listening to this that means you've gotten a hold of the feed early this is just a quick audio preview of what you can expect from our there will be dungeons which starts this saturday so what we have here is character introductions a little dramatic so you're going to hear kind of backstory in a pretty serious way don't worry the actual show is not going to be steeped in this kind of seriousness we hope to be laughing a lot during our live sessions

however we thought it'd be fun for you guys to get an early peek at the characters we're going to be playing for this campaign it starts off with beau explaining the world and then each of us get a chance to talk about the characters we're bringing into that world so anyway i just wanted to give you a heads up on how that works this will also be the feed the podcast for you will get audio edition of the show every time it's posted of course we encourage you to come to the live show which will be saturdays at two p m pacific that's five p m eastern for about three hours on average two hours two to three hours

something like that where we play through this amazing campaign and beau is our able dm and he has got some big plans for us so we're pretty excited about it anyway do that that's at frogpants tv but if you can't and this is the way you want to get it that's fine too because this is where i'll be putting it anyway sit back and enjoy our our character introductions for the first season of their will be dungeons it has been countless millennia

since this world was ruled by humans they once danced in the light and they once touched the sky opening the doors to heaven but in an instant it and alien invaders from deep in the cosmos right to the gates and rained an inferno on their guard they were right and they brought with them fire and hatred but humankind fought back they created battle machine those machines created machines and with those machines failed they made with demons in the darkest places of the world speakable monster with their champions astride them the humans turned the tide of war and slew the dragons by the thousands from their husks the humans created engines whose parts never rusted or broke whose pistons operated ceaselessly and whose combustion was interminable irradiating our world with mana way that allowed them to wield terrible magic the war rained for a send tree more as humankind dragon kind ground their numbers to dust the dragons some of the last of their spite and scorched the lands with it and vanished there only remains the dragon engines used to power the last bastions of hope in a dying world if you could

if you could see past the scars if you could look beyond the tumors and craters if you could peer through the stinging grit and torn soul of nash magy you'd find light blinding rending destructive terrible light look deeper and you would find a man who could blot out the very sun and

take this land beyond the repair of man or machine one who could bring pure and permanent darkness with his curse taking this decaying festering world to its final grand rest but but if you look yet deeper at nash magar there is more than this you would find a spark of something like salvation something like

redemption something small but able perhaps willing to face down the darker temptations that surround it ind e ed indeed there may yet be a time when the name magard is spoken in this desolation without revulsion and the flow of tears from frightened children perhaps there will come a time when he will be remembered as something more something

better however that day is not now his path is new his countless years in the solar mines are well behind him in his leaving wake there lies devastation of the wicked and the righteous his escape left none to tell what they had seen history would never know what happened there but nash knew and that would haunt him but it would also fuel him

like the ancient oil grounds did for the upright men before the fall of millennia ago it is near dawn now he stamps out the remains of his cookfire with his tattered boot and looks to the west with one eye the other burns sightless and dormant and waits for the next chance to play its dark and terrible role he takes his staff from its resting place among the stones throws his threadbare

satchel over his pure shoulder and puts the rising sun to his back he knows not who he will meet nor what he will face and he doesn't care what comes will come and when it does nash will be ready to face it he takes a final look over his shoulder back toward the blood canyons the only home he'd ever known he can never go back he knows this and yet his heart

still aches for the one long lost perhaps a story for a different time his boots left dusty footprints as he walked the only evidence that nash maggard was here they would soon be blown to oblivion by the next storm like a chapter in the old books his page was turning and he was turning with it and for now that was enough the light

the light fades the vision dims all that remains are memories we tell of a time of chaos ruined dreams this wasted land but there are those of us that speak of hope the way the world could be to recall what it was like we have to go back to the other time when this world was blue and green and the desert sprouted

life gone now swept away for reasons long forgotten mighty dragons came from beyond and touched off a blaze which all without a means to fight the humans were nothing they were made of naught but straw the thundering creatures roared and pillaged heroes fought and fought and fought but nothing could stem the conflagration

the world crumbled life exploded a whirlwind of death a firestorm of fear men began to feed on men for those that survived it was a nightmare with no end only those brave enough to seek help desperate enough to live would find the demons and make the dark pact the demons took over

the land ready to wage war and win back the world from the dragons and in this maelstrom of decay the tieflings emerged powerful and strong men and women the warriors designed to destroy the dragons in the roar of battle we lost everything and became a shell of what we were a burnt out desolate race a race haunted by the demons of the past

a race that wandered out into the waste land and it was here in this blighted place that we learned to live again and so began our journey to right the wrong toerase the past among us we found a new promise the tiefling who would travel back and complete the pact hope and just as my ancestral stories have foretold i've travelled far beyond the reach of society's

misconceptions the dragon engines the precious engines are hidden across the world and i'm going to find one head back to the past and restore this world to its former glory the current way's plan this is the last we'll ever see of it it will live on only in our memories my name is stan my name is stanley billings and i'm going to

save this wasteland take a look around you you'll see what i've seen my entire life brutality hopelessness death i was once right there with you i've had my fair share of bad choices just to see another miserable day that all changed when i found the artifact tome of forgotten knowledge that opened my eyes to not only what was but also what could be

i learned the words that we had long forgotten words like society liberty and the path to these ideals government you see it's the lawless nature of this world that has held it in chaos for so long needs is the right person willing to do whatever it takes to push that chaos back into order am i the man to do this you bet your ass

i am after all i'm stanley billings and i'm going to save this wasteland between the rocky between the rocky crags of the job and the endless wastes of ka egro there lives a creature of untold strength and tremendous fortitude a raw untamed pillar of rocky scales and

muscle blasted by sand and sun born to the barbarous lizard folk whose deeds go unseen by civilized eyes borel rasvio kurd the bountiful slaughter remains the last of his desert kin seven feet tall his gait a brawny swagger for rel now ventures towards the dilapidated town of dust

hill a massive bloody haunch of meat slowing atop his broad shoulder and adequate trade for the life giving waters that sustain his desert wanderings but fate seeks to break his isolation the desert stars tell of great change ancient machines and beasts rise from their dormant slumber the world was once shaped by steel and oil
it will now be forged with bone and sinew behold the great adventure of our time begins now
